exposure: Endometrial plasma cells stained for CD138
Plasma cell count per 10 HPFs (thresholds of 1, 5, and 10)
cohort: The study included 80 women undergoing IVF who had endometrial samples obtained prospectively.
finding: Endometrial plasma cells are present in half the general infertile population and do not predict implantation, clinical pregnancy, clinical pregnancy loss, or live birth rates at low levels.
followup_time: Until pregnancy outcome (live birth, clinical pregnancy loss)
